projects.name: Dialogue AI (Personal Project)
projects.tagline: Local-first AI companion desktop app with 3-tier privacy memory pipeline
projects.description: Architected a local-first AI companion desktop app using Next.js 16, Electron, and embedded PocketBase, decoupling real-time chat interfaces from asynchronous background observer agents to eliminate UI latency. Engineered a 3-tier privacy-focused memory pipeline using Markdown storage and on-device vector embeddings (xenova/multilingual-e5-small) for auditable semantic recall. Orchestrated autonomous AI agent workflows leveraging Mastra framework and Playwright for deep web research and document parsing under human-in-the-loop gates.
highlights: Architected a local-first AI companion desktop app using Next.js 16, Electron, and embedded PocketBase, decoupling real-time chat interfaces from asynchronous background observer agents to eliminate UI latency.

Engineered a 3-tier privacy-focused memory pipeline utilizing Markdown file storage and on-device vector embeddings (xenova/multilingual-e5-small) for auditable semantic recall with zero cloud dependency.
Orchestrated autonomous AI agent workflows leveraging Mastra framework and Playwright for deep web research, document parsing, and task automation under a strict human-in-the-loop approval gate.

projects.name: ATMOS E-Commerce & Editorial Web App (Personal Project)
projects.tagline: Full-stack Neo-Brutalist editorial web store with real-time reactive sync
projects.description: Architected a modern full-stack web platform using React 19, Vite 8, and Tailwind CSS v4, implementing a responsive Neo-Brutalist design system with dynamic routing via React Router v7. Built a Headless CMS and i18n ecosystem using Sanity Studio and i18next for seamless content management across artist rosters and multi-language user sessions.
highlights: Architected a modern full-stack web platform using React 19, Vite 8, and Tailwind CSS v4, implementing a responsive Neo-Brutalist design system with dynamic routing via React Router v7.

projects.name: AI-Powered Gemstone Classification System (Personal Project)
projects.tagline: Computer vision pipeline for 87 gemstone categories with FastAPI backend
projects.role: AI and Software Engineer, Self Initiated
projects.description: Developed and fine-tuned a PyTorch (ResNet50) deep learning pipeline using transfer learning on 6,700+ images across 87 gemstone categories, achieving 92.8% training accuracy and perfect F1-scores (100%) on 14 fine-grained classes. Engineered a high-performance FastAPI backend featuring thread-safe lazy model loading and asynchronous request handling to deliver real-time image inferences with Top-5 class confidence scores. Built an interactive web dashboard with drag-and-drop upload and established an automated Pytest test suite covering 8 critical API scenarios.
highlights: Developed and fine-tuned a PyTorch (ResNet50) deep learning pipeline using transfer learning on 6,700+ images across 87 gemstone categories, achieving 92.8% training accuracy and perfect F1-scores (100%) on 14 fine-grained classes.
Engineered a high-performance FastAPI backend featuring thread-safe lazy model loading and asynchronous request handling to deliver real-time image inferences with Top-5 class confidence scores.
Built an interactive web dashboard with drag-and-drop image upload and established an automated Pytest test suite covering 8 critical API scenarios with a 100% pass rate.

projects.name: ExifSense – Browser-Native Metadata & Forensic Tool (Personal Project)
projects.tagline: Client-side metadata analysis and forensic detection tool with zero cloud dependency
projects.description: Architected a zero-server, client-side metadata analysis tool using Vanilla JavaScript and Exifr to parse raw EXIF, GPS, and optical camera parameters from multi-format images with 100% local data privacy. Engineered metadata sanitization and forensic detection features to automatically flag software edit signatures and timestamp discrepancies, enabling one-click client-side removal of sensitive tags. Integrated geospatial route visualization and multi-format exports (PDF, CSV, Markdown, JSON) using Leaflet.js, OSRM, and jsPDF.
highlights: Architected a zero-server, client-side metadata analysis tool using Vanilla JavaScript and Exifr to parse raw EXIF, GPS, and optical camera parameters from multi-format images (JPEG, HEIC, RAW, DNG) with 100% local data privacy.

Engineered metadata sanitization and forensic detection features to automatically flag software edit signatures and timestamp discrepancies, enabling one-click client-side removal of sensitive location and device tags.

Integrated geospatial route visualization and multi-format exports using Leaflet.js, OSRM, and jsPDF, supporting dynamic localization (EN, ID, AR with RTL) and report generation in PDF, CSV, Markdown, and JSON.
